{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for defined contribution plans and medical savings accounts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Individuals should be free to manage their own health care needs through Flexible Savings Accounts (FSAs) and Medical Savings Accounts (MSAs).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Initiatives such as defined contribution plans and medical savings accounts make a government takeover of health care as anachronistic as surgery without anesthesia.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to make defined contribution plans and medical savings accounts the vanguard of a new consumer rights movement in health care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Individuals should be able to roll over excess FSA dollars from one year to the next, instead of losing their unspent money at the end of each year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"MSAs should be a permanent part of tax law, offered to all workers without restriction, with both employers and employees allowed to contribute.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
